chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام did not consider madhy to require wudu (ablution), nor washing of whatever of it affected the garment.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amir al-Mu'minin, Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Does madhy invalidate wudu (ablution) or require washing clothing in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports the legal view of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding madhy. It indicates that madhy does not invalidate wudu (ablution) and that if it reaches one's clothing, washing the affected part is not required.
